Personal finance guide

Income Tax Planning Guide India

Compare old and new tax regimes, deductions, HRA, salary structure, and tax-saving decisions.

Do not choose a regime by guesswork

The old tax regime can help users with deductions such as 80C, HRA, home loan interest, medical insurance, and other eligible benefits. The new regime may work better when deductions are limited.

The right choice depends on your salary structure, deductions, rent, investments, and employer declarations.

Use official documents for filing

A calculator is useful for planning, but filing should be based on Form 16, AIS, salary slips, investment proofs, and official tax rules.

Tax slabs and rebate rules can change after the Union Budget, so review the calculation each financial year.

Tax planning should not force bad investments

A tax-saving product should still match your liquidity needs, risk profile, and goals. Locking money only for tax benefit can create cash-flow stress.

Compare ELSS, PPF, EPF, insurance premiums, home loan principal, and other deductions based on both tax impact and financial usefulness.

Action checklist

  • - Collect salary slips and Form 16 details.
  • - List all eligible deductions and exemptions.
  • - Compare old and new regimes before declaring.
  • - Keep proofs for employer and filing records.
  • - Review tax rules after Budget updates.
